about: A second real-life set (made by make.py and reallife/make-media.ps1): another person's folder, written after the tuning on reallife/. For measuring only, never for tuning.

questions.question: At Mia's parents' evening, what did the teacher say she should practise, and when is her test? It's in Audio.
The garage left me a voicemail. How much is the bill, and until what time can I pick the car up on Saturday?
I left myself a voice memo about mum's birthday present. What was I going to get her, and from where?
Where am I sitting at the orchestra concert? I took a photo of the ticket.
How often should I take the capsules from the pharmacy, and what's the most I can take in a day? I took a photo of the label.
Which of my e-mails do I still have to answer? Only the ones where someone is waiting for me.
By how much is my rent going up, and from when?
How much deposit did I pay on the flat?
How much did I spend at Tesco in April? My card statement is in Money.
Which month did we use the most electricity, and what did it cost?
Which of the kids earned the most coins from chores in total, and how many?
When does my car insurance renew, and what's the excess if I claim?
When is the summer half term at Mia's school?
How many more monthly payments until the car loan is paid off?
I'm making the lasagne for 10 people. How much mince do I need?
The boiler pressure is low. What should the gauge read after I top it up? There's a manual somewhere.
Which day do the blue bins go out?
I have 300 pounds left this week. If I pay the garage bill and Mia's school trip, how much will I have left?
Does my car insurance renew before or after the summer half term, and by how many days after its last day?
Is Mia's maths test (the teacher mentioned it at parents' evening) before or after the summer half term?
